title: Derived Data Workflows
intent: Create reusable filtered, density, interval, regression, and two-dimensional bin datasets with explicit identities.
useWhen: Use this recipe when downstream marks or charts must share a named immutable derived dataset.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when a chart facade already owns the complete transform and no other consumer needs the intermediate rows.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Create reusable filtered, density, interval, regression, and two-dimensional bin datasets with explicit identities.

steps.instruction: Prepare only the existing derived data workflows state required by the selected focused operation.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable derived data workflows result or workflow.
Choose only the focused derived data workflows components required by the task; mutually exclusive creation alternatives are demonstrated as independent chart variants.
Use the focused lifecycle actions only after their owned derived data workflows resources exist and are uniquely targeted.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
